Postmerge Round 2 C7 fixture repair after C6: with item drops the former grant-only fixture ends the slow phase at P about 236 and never evaluates the OT=240 island-3 gate. Keep the same shipped enemies, unlocks and Cut +1200 grant; use test-only Decomposed CMove=2 to obtain a qualifying lethal gate on day 3 at P=240.174, loss/H=1.217. SameAsFast and CurrentHealth reject it; None selects it, dies and respawns once; island 4 stays closed. Independent shipped-TC3 oracle still asserts loss/H about 4.16. These exact keys describe the repaired coverage fixture, not calibration. Defaults, ORIGINAL and all tolerances unchanged.
